messages:
mike: Heads up — billing alerts showing spikes for a handful of Dedicated tenants after last night's surge. Looks like fallback attempts are emitting separate charge events.

jen: Yikes. Is this the fallback handler that tags `penalty_emitted`?

mike: Exactly. Flow is: client -> edge -> transient 502 -> proxy retries (generates attempt-id) -> routed to fallback which emits an event with penalty=true -> original request eventually succeeds and emits normal event.

arun: Do we have concrete event examples?

mike: Pulled two lines from our metering bucket: 
```
ts=2026-03-20T02:12:11Z tenant=zephyr tokens=240 route=dedicated-gpu tags=[penalty_emitted, retry] req_id=req_9f8a\n

ts=2026-03-20T02:12:11Z tenant=zephyr tokens=240 route=dedicated-gpu tags=[] req_id=req_9f8a_attempt_1
```

kate: So proxy rewrote req_id on retry. We count both. 

tom: Short term we can dedupe in postproc by (tenant, req_base_id, minute) where req_base_id strips `_attempt_*`. But that's heuristic and could fold real parallel requests if they share IDs.

jen: Can we instead tighten the header contract? Require `x-request-id` and treat `x-attempt-id` separately. Backwards compat: if `x-original-request-id` present use that in dedupe.

arun: Good. Meanwhile we should stop emitting penalty events from fallback until proxies are fixed  otherwise the damage continues.

billing-bot: ALERT: invoice_preview anomalies +22% for tenant zephyr in last 30m — https://console/redwood/invoices/preview/zephyr

kate: I agree with the dual approach: hotfix fallback to stop penalty emit + ingest-side normalization/dedupe. Also add telemetry tag `metering_dedupe_v0` so we can roll metrics.

mike: Proposed rollout: 1) hotfix fallback (immediately), 2) ingest lambda add normalization (canary 2%), 3) console tile showing "duplicate-suspects" with ability to mark for audit, 4) backfill dedupe for 48h flagged as "audit adjustments".

jen: Who owns the canary? I can. I'll watch for under-reporting (false dedupe).

arun: I'll update the API contract doc and add server-side enforcement to prefer `x-original-request-id` when present.

mike: Ops window tonight 23:30-00:30 UTC for lambda canary.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY: hotfix/fallback-stop-penalty deployed to canary at 5381235075 by mike — tags: hotfix/no-penalty-emit

kate: Canary metrics for 20m: penalty_event_count dropped to near-zero. Ingest error rate unchanged. No sign of undercounting on sampling tenants.

jen: Ingest normalization canary deployed to 2% at 5381235120. Tagging all normalized events with `metering_dedupe_v0`.

mike: Sent CS note with tenant list and "invoice preview may show pending audit adjustments".

arun: Console PR: https://git/redwood/console/pulls/4590 adds duplicate-suspects card + drilldown. Also adds endpoint to flag candidates for manual review.

kate: Let's not backfill automatically. Ops/legal wants a manual approval step. Backfill job prepared but gated behind audit-approval workflow.

jen: For QA, test vector: req_id=req_testabc, attempt rewrite produced req_testabc_attempt_3 — ingest should map to req_testabc and set `normalized=true`. Verify dedupe card picks it up.

billing-bot: NOTE: invoice_preview for zephyr decreased by 0.9% after hotfix. Continued monitoring advised.

mike: Thanks. We'll reconvene tomorrow after 24h of canary metrics. If safe, increase canary to 20% then full roll. :thumbsup:
